en: A vintage colored postcard showing a harbor scene with several sailboats docked, a prominent metal bridge spanning a river, and a town with a notable multi-tiered church tower in the background. The architecture is typical of Northern or Eastern European towns, with red-tiled roofs and classic town buildings. There is text printed in red at the top left of the postcard.
